items.title: Fake PS5 emulators on GitHub are spreading password-stealing malware

items.lede: Malware disguised as two popular PS5 game emulators, distributed via GitHub, has been identified as stealing passwords from unsuspecting gamers.
items.title: Fake PS5 emulators are being used to steal gamers' passwords — two well-known GitHub repos, including popular AnyPS5, get hit, infecting gamers' computers with password-scraping malware
